question: Where’s the closest fast food restaurant on the journey from Bowditch Middle School Auditorium, Foster City, CA toward Oldest Light Bulb, Livermore, CA?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'fast_food' ORDER BY ST_Distance( geometry::geography, ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Bowditch Middle School Auditorium%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Foster City%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Oldest Light Bulb%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Livermore%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography ) ASC LIMIT 1;
